rules: Existing scalar/pilot NLM only,patch5 search21,mean lag noise correction,selfweight=max neighbor. Full256 supports measured230 with halo13. Calibrate h on independent flat seed within fixed .02..2 range,matched residual std within2percent;verify another seed without retuning. Four frozen natural supports,3planes,2known Gaussian covariances,2trials=48 observations. No newRAW/no blind noise estimate/no production reference substitution.
limitations: Original natural pixels contain unknown noise and serve only as fixed surrogate signal. Added sigma.01 identical across planes is an artificial stress,not camera noise. White/binomial noise not real RCD noise model. Source noise can be preserved as signal. Matched flat residual noise does not guarantee equal residual on structures. Calibration and trials share same covariance assumptions,not real independent confirmation. No quality-to-production/E-P/LR claim;MSE normalized by injected noise sigma only. Timings tiny Python patches,not application latency.
